data.one_liner: Checks if the user has the latest app version and prompts an update link.
data.what_it_does: The plugin queries the app store for the current version of the app and compares it to the installed version. If an update is available it can show a platform‑specific alert with a link to the store.
use_when: You need to ensure users run the newest version of your app
You want a simple way to prompt updates without building custom store‑lookup logic
avoid_when: Your app does not have store listings (e.g., internal distribution)
You require complex update policies beyond a simple version check
strengths: Handles both iOS and Android store lookups
weaknesses: Relies on external store APIs which may change
Limited to basic version comparison, no staged rollouts

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer to implement your own store‑lookup logic using raw HTTP requests

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides more advanced networking features if you need custom request handling

data.minimal_example:
final newVersion = NewVersion();
await newVersion.showAlertIfNecessary(context: context);
